{
  "manifest_schema": 1,
  "id": "vendor.runtime",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "display_name": "Workbench runtime fixture",
  "host_api": { "minimum": "0.0.1", "maximum": "99.0.0" },
  "protocol": 1,
  "provider": { "mode": "persistent", "binaries": { "aarch64-apple-darwin": "bin/provider", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu": "bin/provider" } },
  "actions": [{
    "id": "vendor.runtime.open",
    "label": "Open workbench runtime",
    "description": "Open another exact-definition workbench instance",
    "category": "vendor.runtime",
    "contexts": ["dashboard"],
    "arguments": [],
    "timeout_seconds": 60,
    "destructive": false,
    "confirmation": "none",
    "handler": "open",
    "allowed_outcomes": ["navigate-declared-route"]
  }],
  "panels": [{
    "id": "vendor.runtime.list",
    "model_kinds": ["list"],
    "event_schema": [{ "kind": "selected", "arguments": [] }],
    "handler": "runtime-list",
    "ports": []
  }],
  "routes": [{ "id": "vendor.runtime.open", "activation_fields": [], "target_screen": "vendor.runtime.review" }],
  "screens": [{ "path": "screens/main.screen.toml", "screen_ids": ["vendor.runtime.review"] }]
}

screen_schema = 1
id = "vendor.runtime.review"
title = "Workbench Runtime Review"
route = "vendor.runtime.open"
initial_focus = "review"
focus_order = ["review"]

[[overlays]]
kind = "help"

[[bindings]]
context = "dashboard"
action = "vendor.runtime.open"

[[bindings]]
context = "dashboard"
action = "dashboard.open-help"

[[panels]]
id = "review"
type = "vendor.runtime.list"
focusable = true
required = true

[layout]
type = "leaf"
panel = "review"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
next_request=100003
next_request_id() {
  request_id="p-$next_request"
  next_request=$((next_request + 1))
}
send_outcome() {
  next_request_id
  printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"outcome\",\"request_id\":\"$request_id\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"kind\":\"navigate\",\"route_id\":\"vendor.runtime.open\",\"activation\":{}}}"
}
send_snapshot() {
  panel_instance_id=$1
  panel_generation=$2
  revision=$3
  title=$4
  selected_id=$5
  next_request_id
  printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"panel-snapshot\",\"request_id\":\"$request_id\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"model_schema\":1,\"panel_instance_id\":$panel_instance_id,\"generation\":$panel_generation,\"revision\":$revision,\"kind\":\"list\",\"title\":\"$title\",\"loading\":false,\"action_affordances\":[],\"body\":{\"kind\":\"list\",\"items\":[{\"id\":\"alpha\",\"label\":\"Alpha runtime item\",\"actions\":[]},{\"id\":\"beta\",\"label\":\"Beta runtime item\",\"actions\":[]}],\"selected_id\":\"$selected_id\"}}}"
}
read -r hello
process_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$hello" | sed -n 's/.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"hello-ack\",\"request_id\":\"p-100001\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"provider_name\":\"workbench-runtime\",\"protocol\":1}}"
read -r configure
printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"ready\",\"request_id\":\"p-100002\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{\"capabilities\":[\"actions\",\"panels\"]}}"
activation_count=0
first_panel_id=
first_panel_generation=
while read -r message; do
  case "$message" in
    *'"type":"invoke-action"'*)
      send_outcome
      ;;
    *'"type":"activate-panel"'*)
      panel_instance_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$message" | sed -n 's/.*"panel_instance_id":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
      panel_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$message" | sed -n 's/.*"payload":{.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
      activation_count=$((activation_count + 1))
      case "$activation_count" in
        1)
          first_panel_id=$panel_instance_id
          first_panel_generation=$panel_generation
          send_snapshot "$panel_instance_id" "$panel_generation" 1 "First workbench instance" alpha
          ;;
        2)
          send_snapshot "$panel_instance_id" "$panel_generation" 1 "Second workbench instance" alpha
          ;;
        3)
          case "$message" in
            *'"prior_host_local":{"scroll_offset":0,"selected_id":"beta"}'*) ;;
            *) printf '%s\n' "missing exact-instance prior host state: $message" >&2; exit 42 ;;
          esac
          send_snapshot "$panel_instance_id" "$panel_generation" 1 "First workbench instance resumed" beta
          ;;
        *)
          ;;
      esac
      ;;
    *'"type":"panel-event"'*)
      panel_instance_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$message" | sed -n 's/.*"panel_instance_id":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
      panel_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$message" | sed -n 's/.*"payload":{.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
      if [ "$panel_instance_id" = "$first_panel_id" ] && [ "$panel_generation" = "$first_panel_generation" ]; then
        send_snapshot "$panel_instance_id" "$panel_generation" 2 "First workbench instance selected beta" beta
      fi
      ;;
    *'"type":"shutdown"'*)
      next_request_id
      printf '%s\n' "{\"protocol\":1,\"type\":\"shutdown-ack\",\"request_id\":\"$request_id\",\"generation\":$process_generation,\"payload\":{}}"
      exit 0
      ;;
  esac
done
